_note: Extra states for the plan 10 §7 gates and catalog reach (object-detective v3). Module states m1-m5 come from the stepper. Gallery views are places a learner walks to with the camera rig (WASD, drag, double-click); each one is a rig view inside the room, not a framing chosen for a gate. Case states open the Now-card steps and the drawers a learner opens from the card. The v2 built-in state start-shift is replaced by these states.

extraStates.label: Walk up to the north wall cases

extraStates.name: walk-south
extraStates.label: Turn round to the entrance (reception, exit, bench cases)

extraStates.name: c1-brief
extraStates.label: Case 1, step 1: Open the draft card (drawer)

extraStates.name: c1-lens
extraStates.label: Case 1, inspect: spot 1 with the lens on

steps.eval: (async () => { const L = window.__TEST__.lessons; L._setCaseStep('tutorial', 'inspect'); await L.chooseSpot('f-number'); if (!L.stage.magnifier.on) L.toggle('lens'); })()

extraStates.name: c1-light
extraStates.label: Case 1, inspect: spot 4 with the raking light on

steps.eval: (async () => { const L = window.__TEST__.lessons; L._setCaseStep('tutorial', 'inspect'); if (L.stage.magnifier.on) L.toggle('lens'); await L.chooseSpot('f-underside'); if (!L.stage.rake.on) L.toggle('light'); })()

(() => { const L = window.__TEST__.lessons; L._setCaseStep('tutorial', 'inspect'); if (L.stage.rake.on) L.toggle('light'); if (L.stage.magnifier.on) L.toggle('lens'); if (!L.stage.trueSize) L.toggle('size'); })()

extraStates.name: c1-archive
extraStates.label: Case 1, step 3: Open the records drawer

steps.eval: (() => { const L = window.__TEST__.lessons; if (L.stage.trueSize) L.toggle('size'); L._setCaseStep('tutorial', 'archive'); L.openCaseDrawer('tutorial', 'archive'); })()

extraStates.name: c2-compare
extraStates.label: Case 2, inspect: compare two objects side by side

steps.eval: (async () => { const L = window.__TEST__.lessons; L._setCaseStep('main', 'inspect'); await L.compareNext(); })()

extraStates.name: c2-board
extraStates.label: Case 2, step 4: Open the evidence board (drawer)

steps.eval: (async () => { const L = window.__TEST__.lessons; if (L.stage.compareId) await L.stage.setCompare(null); L._caseGo('main', 'board'); })()

extraStates.name: c2-label
extraStates.label: Case 2, step 5: Open the label writer (drawer)
